lines.text: Joseph's physicians embalmed Israel, which took forty days, and the Egyptians mourned for him seventy days.
Pharaoh told Joseph to go up and bury his father in Canaan, and Pharaoh's servants went with him.
At the threshing floor of Atad, Joseph mourned seven days, and his sons buried Jacob in the cave at Shechem.
The brothers bowed and called themselves his judges, but Joseph said not to be afraid and promised to provide for them.
Joseph lived to 110, made the sons of Israel swear to carry his bones up, and was placed in a coffin in Egypt.
